permissions.description: Permissions to keep while the delegation token is applied. These must be a subset of the caller's current permissions for the site and cannot include ADMIN.

onBehalfOf.description: User identity to store in the signed delegation token.

username.description: Username to use for activity/audit attribution when the delegation token is applied.

onBehalfOf.title: DelegationTokenPrincipal

reason.description: Reason the delegation token is being generated. Stored in the signed token for audit/support traceability.
